title: Resolved interaction-scenario recipe options
description: What `mdux-scenariobake` was asked to do when compiling one `.scenario` script (#319, ADR-020): the artifact id, the script source, and the committed screen the script is scripted against, plus the resolved dynamic-capture `verification` the second stage records (#321, ADR-021). Describes the **resolved** option set a baker records in `report.json`'s `options`, with every default expanded - not the literal TOML a recipe file carries. ADR-007 decision 4 is why. Checked against every committed report by tools/docs-lint/check_schema_type_drift.py.

id.description: The artifact id, which names the directory under `generated/scenario/`.

screen.description: The committed screen id the script names. The compiler reads `generated/screen/<screen>/package.json` to resolve every `pointer <node>` directive to that node's rectangle centre and to reject a directive naming a node the screen does not carry.

verification.description: What the dynamic scenario-capture stage was asked to cover (#321, ADR-021). Both lists are derived from the scenario and the screen's approval manifest rather than supplied, so a run cannot narrow what it reports on.

captures.description: The scenario's declared `capture` markers, each rendered and checked in every approved locale.

locales.description: The approved locales each capture frame is rendered and verified in.

items.description: A locale tag rendered and checked.
